parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the authorization. The name must be unique.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The number of the page to return. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 10.

parameters.name: VpcAccessId
parameters.description: The ID of the VPC authorization.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudapi describe-vpc-accesses --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --name wuying-edm-svc --vpc-access-id vpc-00000ssds24 --accurate-query false --vpc-id vpc-uf657qec7lx42paw3qxxx --instance-id 10.199.26.000 --port 8080 --tag Value=product Key=appname --api-version 2016-07-14 --region cn-hangzhou
